system.description:
As a Reaction, to an allied creature within 30 feet of you taking damage you can spend 1 Ingot to project a metallic shield, intercepting damage, acting as a barrier for them. The barrier projected has hit points equal to 2d6 + 6 and DR equal to your highest ability modifier. Its hit points increase by +1d6 at 7th, and 15th levels. This barrier lasts until the beginning of your next turn.
